programme.desc: Albie e Tiffany vengono mandati a casa della zia per le vacanze. Qui i ragazzi conoscono un gruppo di bizzarri coetanei emarginati, impegnati nella ricerca di un fantomatico tesoro.

programme.title: Air Bud 5: un amico dal tocco magico
programme.desc: Buddy sta portando il suo show nelle spiaggie grazie ad un nuovo sport: il beach volley! La vita in spiaggia non è così rilassante come sembra. Un'ondata di furti misteriosi ha colpito la città e sono state trovate impronte di zampe sulle scene del crimine.

programme.title: Mr. Magorium e la bottega
programme.desc: Molly Mahoney è la goffa e insicura della Bottega delle Meraviglie di Mr. Magorium, il negozio di giocattoli più strano e fantastico del mondo.

programme.title: The Amazing Wizard Of Paws

programme.title: Big Baby
programme.desc: Uno scienziato progetta una macchina per la trasformazione genetica e il suo nipotino di soli 4 anni si trasforma accidentalmente in un uomo di 30. Il "Bambino" sfugge e corre intorno alla città rincorso dai fratelli che fanno di tutto per recuperarlo prima dell'arrivo dei propri genitori.

programme.title: A Plumm Summer - Una magica estate
programme.desc: Froggie Doo, pupazzo animato protagonista di un fortunato spettacolo televisivo, viene rapito. Due fratellini, Elliott e Rocky Plumm, aiutano l'FBI nelle indagini per recuperare il proprio eroe.

programme.title: Alvin Superstar
programme.desc: La vita del musicista Dave Neville sta per essere sconvolta dall’arrivo di tre scoiattoli canterini: Alvin, Simon e Theodore. Tre forze della natura che, oltre a devastargli la casa, distruggergli la carriera e stravolgergli completamente la vita, si rivelano una band musicale strepitosa.

programme.title: Il regno di Wuba
programme.desc: Uomini e mostri non possono convivere in armonia: i primi, per paura o per diletto, finiranno sempre per andare a caccia dei secondi. Consapevole di questo, la Regina dei Mostri, incinta e minacciata di morte, fa di tutto per preservare la salute del nascituro.

programme.title: Ploi
programme.desc: Ploi è un pulcino di piviere che ha paura a spiccare il volo.

programme.title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic
programme.sub-title: S2:E2 La mega avventura di Brontolorso
programme.desc: Brontolorso viene colto da un temporale magico che lo fa ingrandire ogni volta che si arrabbia. E ogni volta che cresce, si arrabbia di più! Gli Orsetti del Cuore devono lavorare insieme per trovare una soluzione prima che Brontolorso diventi troppo grande per il loro mondo!

programme.title: Care Bears: Unlock the Magic

programme.desc: Fortunello e Splendente catturano un magico Amico Stellare che concede loro mille desideri! All'inizio è divertente, ma i loro continui desideri causano così tanti problemi che vorrebbero non aver mai iniziato!

programme.title: Jumbo
programme.desc: Jumbo è un elefante che vive su un'isola, è molto intelligente e riesce a sillabare qualsiasi parola. Ogni anno si indice una gara dove partecipano numerosi animali, ciascun partecipante deve sillabare una parola senza sbagliare.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Forensic Files II

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.sub-title: S04 : E01 Forensic Files II
programme.desc: Un triangolo amoroso diventato fatale sembra chiuso fino a quando la tecnologia non ne racconta la storia.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S14 : E15 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Nel 2003, Kathy Lorick fu assassinata su una pista da jogging di Concord, in California, in pieno giorno mentre parlava con suo marito al cellulare.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S14 : E10 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Nel 2000, l'adolescente Tara Munsey scompare dopo un turno di lavoro in un ristorante della Virginia.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S14 : E07 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Nel 2005, David Castor subì una morte lenta e straziante nell'arco di giorni. Sua moglie Stacey sosteneva che si trattasse di suicidio, anche se era stato eseguito con l'antigelo.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S13 : E05 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Nel 1996, la polizia di Virginia Beach arrivò nell'appartamento di Makdessi e trovò Elise Makdessi e il suo amante Quincy Brown morti.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S14 : E21 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Nel 1993, la giovane madre Tammy Tatum fu trovata violentata e uccisa nel suo appartamento di Longmont, in Colorado. La polizia inizialmente sospettò del suo ex marito, ma non aveva prove sufficienti per accusarlo e il caso è rimasto irrisolto.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S13 : E32 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Un'auto crivellata di colpi, un autista scomparso e nessun testimone. Fu un agguato o un attacco casuale?

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S12 : E01 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Quando una giovane ragazza venne trovata morta, la polizia arrestò subito il sospetto più probabile. Ma la tecnologia all'avanguardia della NASA permise a un odontoiatra forense di dimostrare che dietro le sbarre vi era l'uomo sbagliato.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S12 : E22 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Nel 1969, l'operatrice telefonica venticinquenne Diane Maxwell venne stuprata e uccisa. Suo fratello promise che avrebbe scoperto il responsabile e assicurato l'assassino alla giustizia.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S14 : E14 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Nel 2004, Rebecca Barney e il suo futuro ex marito Fred furono trovati colpiti a morte nella loro casa di Tulsa, in Oklahoma, che era stata data alle fiamme.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S14 : E20 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Nel 2002, l'impresario funebre Lonnie Turner Sr. fu trovato colpito a morte. Il figlio Lonnie Jr. diventò il primo sospettato, specie dopo che si scoprì che l'omicidio venne commesso con la sua pistola. Tuttavia, aveva un alibi per l'ora del delitto.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S12 : E04 Forensic Files
programme.desc: La videosorveglianza in un casinò seguì i movimenti di una giovane fino a poco prima della sua scomparsa.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S12 : E24 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Una giovane e attraente parrucchiera fu violentata e uccisa nel suo salone di bellezza. Le prove sul luogo del delitto non corrispondevano a nessuno dei sospettati e, dopo l'indagine iniziale, il caso rimase irrisolto per dieci anni.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S13 : E44 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Rachael Mullenix, 19enne, fu condannata per aver pugnalato la madre, Barbara Mullenix, il 13 settembre 2006, e poi aver imballato il suo cadavere insanguinato in una scatola di cartone prima di scaricarlo a Newport Bay, sulla costa della California.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S14 : E05 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Nel 2008, in Illinois i soccorsi giunsero in un incendio in un box e videro un uomo compresso sotto un camion.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S12 : E15 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Nella notte di Halloween del 2004, Adriane Insogna e Leslie Mazzara furono brutalmente uccise nella loro casa di Napa, in California.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S14 : E11 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Nel 1989, i cadaveri di Joan Rogers e delle due figlie adolescenti furono trovati a galleggiare a Tampa Bay.

programme.title: Forensic Files
programme.sub-title: S13 : E14 Forensic Files
programme.desc: Una ragazza viene trovata morta nel suo appartamento. Con poche prove sulla scena, il caso rimane irrisolto.

programme.desc: Un incendio in casa uccide l'unico medico in città. Un'indagine sugli incendi dolosi suggerisce che sia stato il figlio dell'infermiera del medico.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.sub-title: S04 : E06 Forensic Files II
programme.desc: Un appassionato di crimine collega una sconosciuta dello Utah a un caso di persone scomparse dell'Ohio.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.sub-title: S04 : E05 Forensic Files II
programme.desc: Una famiglia piange l'inaspettata morte dell'amata nonna a Natale. La polizia locale assicura a tutti che si è trattato di un tragico incidente e non di un delitto. Ma alcune cose sulla scena non tornano.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.sub-title: S03 : E05 Forensic Files II
programme.desc: Un ex detenuto del Texas è condannato per un omicidio che sostiene di non aver commesso. Da dietro le sbarre, è deciso a usare la scienza forense per dimostrare la sua innocenza.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.sub-title: S04 : E09 Forensic Files II
programme.desc: Un negozio di abbigliamento di lusso a Bethesda, Maryland, rivela una scena raccapricciante: una dipendente, 30 anni, viene trovata morta mentre il suo collega, 28 anni, è malconcio e legato. Le telecamere di sorveglianza fanno luce sul movente.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 Forensic Files II
programme.desc: Quando una donna viene uccisa in un sobborgo del Michigan, la telecamera rivela un trio di killer. Una nota scritta a mano diventa un indizio cruciale.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.sub-title: S04 : E11 Forensic Files II
programme.desc: In California, il DNA di un uomo innocente viene trovato sulla scena di una fatale irruzione in casa.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.sub-title: S03 : E10 Forensic Files II
programme.desc: Quando un marine di 23 anni muore nella sua stanza, i dottori credono che sia stato un attacco di cuore. Ma dopo aver trovato l'arsenico negli organi, sua moglie viene accusata di omicidio. Un avvocato scaltro e test tossicologici scoprono la verità.

programme.title: Forensic Files II
programme.sub-title: S03 : E06 Forensic Files II
programme.desc: I medici non riescono a capire perché una donna della California continua a ammalarsi. Quando muore, gli investigatori scoprono che qualcuno aveva mentito.

programme.desc: Nel 1996, la polizia di Virginia Beach arrivò nell'appartamento di Makdessi e trovò Elise Makdessi e il suo amante Quincy Brown morti.

programme.desc: Nel 2006, Darlene VanderGiesen ricevette e-mail minacciose e poi scomparve. Il monitoraggio della fonte delle e-mail portò la polizia a casa di Daphne Wright, dove credono sia stato commesso un omicidio.

programme.desc: Nel 1995, la cameriera di Palm Beach Denise O'Neill venne rapita e uccisa. Il suo vicino Luis Caballero destò sospetti per il suo strano comportamento nei confronti delle troupe televisive che riprendevano il crimine.

programme.sub-title: S00 : E08 GLORY 103 Rotterdam LHS
programme.desc: GLORY 103: Last Heavyweight Standing main event features Levi Rigters (19-3, 9 KO) colliding with Jamal Ben Saddik (38-10, 29 KO) to see who moves on in the tournament. Among the other names taking part in Phase Two are Nabil Khachab (29-6-1, 4 KO), Iancu Ionut (31-11, 13 KO), Rade Opacic (21-7, 16 KO), Milos Cvjeticanin (13-4, 9 KO), Sofian Laidouni (39-5-1, 20 KO), and many more. In addition, Chico Kwasi (44-5-2, 23 KO) will defend his GLORY welterweight world title against Mehdi Ait El Hadj (35-4-2, 8 KO), Mory Kromah (34-3-1, 20 KO) returns and takes on Cristian Ristea (44-26, 13 KO) in a heavyweight match-up outside the tournament, and Tayfun Ozcan (88-11-3, 28 KO) clashes with rival...

programme.title: Capitan Apache
programme.desc: Durante la presidenza di Grant, il Capitano Apache indaga sull’omicidio del Commissario Collier. Con l’indizio “April Morning”, si scontra con il trafficante Griffin e scopre una rete di omicidi e corruzione sempre più profonda, dove ogni testimone diventa bersaglio.

programme.title: La valle della vendetta
programme.desc: I figli di un barone del bestiame del Colorado, uno biologico e l'altro adottivo, si risentono e lottano per il controllo dell'impero del bestiame del padre.

programme.title: Per il gusto di uccidere
programme.desc: Hank Fellows è un cacciatore di taglie che si dedica anche al recupero del bottino che le bande di rapinatori rubano dalle banche.

programme.title: Il tesoro dei Sequoia
programme.desc: Una colonia di quaccheri cerca di salvare le sequoie giganti da un barone del legname.

programme.title: L'agente speciale Pinkerton
programme.desc: Un agente speciale di Chicago viene mandato a ovest per catturare i famigerati fratelli Reno.

programme.title: SpeciL'uomo, l'orgoglio, la vendetta
programme.desc: Un valoroso soldato spagnolo si rivolge ad una vita di crimine per dimostrare il suo amore per una misteriosa e promiscua donna zingara.

programme.title: Dove si spara di più
programme.desc: Due famiglie rivali vivono in un ciclo di odio e violenza. Quando la figlia dei Campos e il figlio dei Mounter si innamorano, il loro legame proibito accende ancora più rancore, spingendo i clan verso nuove tragedie mentre cercano di difendere ciò che resta del loro onore.

programme.title: La morte sull'alta collina
programme.desc: Un'importante rapina va male, mentre due giovani uomini si ritrovano a ostacolare banditi messicani e malvagi uomini d'affari corrotti che vogliono indietro il loro bottino rubato.

programme.title: Joe... cercati un posto per morire!
programme.desc: Un soldato confederato emarginato trova il riscatto quando decide di proteggere una donna da brutali banditi pronti a tutto pur di prendere la sua concessione mineraria. Nel confronto che segue, il soldato scopre una nuova forza e un motivo per combattere oltre il proprio passato.

programme.title: Il suo nome è qualcuno
programme.desc: Finisce l'avventura di due soldati ribelli dopo la Guerra Civile.

programme.title: La Battaglia di Forte Apache
programme.desc: I rinnegati che cercano di convincere l'esercito ad abbandonare il loro forte fanno assuefare gli indiani al whisky, poi li convincono ad attaccare e scacciare i soldati.

programme.title: Sei bounty killers per una strage
programme.desc: Un western classico ricco di avventura, dove in una città senza legge una banda di criminali impone il proprio dominio. Ma quando la giustizia viene calpestata, qualcuno è sempre pronto a reagire. Tra scontri e coraggio, nasce una sfida per riportare l’ordine e difendere ciò che conta davvero.

programme.title: Più forte sorelle
programme.desc: Un cacciatore di taglie di nome Amen viene assunto da un gruppo di suore per recuperare il denaro rubato. Le suore sono donne disperate travestite, che vogliono che il bottino venga saccheggiato da un fuorilegge di nome Catapult e dalla sua banda.

programme.title: La colt era il suo Dio
programme.desc: Una banda di briganti guidata da Manuel semina terrore a Landford City. Lo sceriffo chiede aiuto all’esercito, che manda il capitano Mike Jackson nella sua città natale per indagare e trovare un agente scomparso. Appena arriva, Jackson finisce subito nel mezzo di violenti scontri e sparatorie con i banditi.

programme.title: Come vinsi la guerra
programme.desc: Quando le spie dell'Unione rubano l'amata locomotiva di un ingegnere, lui la insegue da solo e direttamente attraverso le linee nemiche.

programme.title: La notte senza legge
programme.desc: Cowboys e ranchers devono mettere da parte le loro differenze quando una banda di fuorilegge, guidata dal capitano dell'esercito Jack Bruhn, decide di passare la notte in una piccola città del West.

programme.title: I due volti della vendetta
programme.desc: Dopo aver rapinato una banca messicana, papà Longworth prende il bottino e lascia il suo compagno Rio per essere catturato ma Rio fugge e cerca papà in California.

programme.title: Ed ora... raccomanda l'anima a Dio!
programme.desc: Due uomini stanno andando a Denver City per regolare un conto personale. Uno cerca l'assassino di suo padre, l'altro un ex amico che gli ha rubato l'oro. A loro si unisce una terza persona, un misterioso pistolero.

programme.title: Il mio nome è Shangai Joe
programme.desc: Un karategewandtes Gelbgesicht geht in den Wilden Westen, um Cowboy zu werden. Dort trifft er auf den brutalen Spencer, der mit seiner Bande Menschenschmuggel betreibt und Mexikaner reihenweise wie Freiwild erschießen lässt.

programme.title: La morte cavalca a Rio Bravo
programme.desc: La morte cavalca a Rio Bravo - Un ex ufficiale dell'esercito uccide accidentalmente il figlio di una donna e cerca di rimediare scortando il corteo funebre attraverso il pericoloso territorio indiano.

programme.title: Ramon il Messicano
programme.desc: Una terrificante storia di omicidio e vendetta che si svolge mentre Slim Baxter tenta di distruggere la terribile banda di Morales e salvare la sua adorabile sposa Esmeralda.

programme.title: Dio in cielo... Arizona in terra
programme.desc: Arizona, cacciatore di taglie, interviene per aiutare contadini oppressi contro il potente Austin Styles e la sua banda di fuorilegge. Tra inganni e pericoli, diventa il loro unico alleato nella lotta per proteggere le terre e la vita.

programme.title: La lunga cavalcata della vendetta
programme.desc: Jeff si propone di uccidere ciascuno dei cinque fuorilegge che hanno derubato, violentato e ucciso la sua povera sorella. Depone un frammento del suo poncho su ciascuno dei cadaveri delle sue vittime come segno della sua vendetta in un racconto avvincente ed emozionante.

programme.title: Se sei vivo spara
programme.desc: Varie fazioni, faida per l'oro rubato in una città surreale.

programme.title: Il momento di uccidere
programme.desc: Lord e Bull sono due avventurieri reclutati dal giudice Warren per una misteriosa missione. Giunti al villaggio per conoscere i dettagli della missione, non trovano il giudice e scoprono che molte persone li vogliono morti.

programme.title: Kid il monello del west
programme.desc: Kid Terror O’Hara guida un gruppo di bambini in una fantomatica rapina in banca a River City per gioco e per farsi prendere sul serio. Con astuzia, esplosivi e diversivi, riescono nell’impresa. Ma i fuorilegge cercano vendetta e i bambini devono spiegare tutto allo sceriffo prima che sia troppo tardi.

programme.title: W Django!
programme.desc: Django è sulle tracce di alcuni fuorilegge rinnegati che hanno violentato e ucciso sua moglie. Durante il viaggio, salva un ladro di cavalli da un'improvvisa impiccagione. Scopre che l'uomo sa chi ha commesso l'omicidio. Gli uomini si uniscono e si dirigono a ovest per vendicarsi.

programme.title: Killer, adios
programme.desc: Ein junger Mann kehrt zehn Jahre nach der Ermordung des Mörders seiner Eltern in seine Heimatstadt zurück. Dort angekommen, wird er gebeten, dem Sheriff zu helfen.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 Teddy Bear Picnic
programme.desc: Teddy Bears of all age, shape, and size join our grill team with their owners for a day of games, rides and some teddy bear repair. Matt & the RG team are BBQing a menu even the pickiest eater will love. The menu: Grilled Almond Butter & Banana Sandwiches, Grilled Meatball Sub, Smoked White Cheddar Macaroni, and Quick & Snappy Ginger Lemon Ice Cream Sandwiches.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 Animal Care Fundraiser
programme.desc: Llamas, horses, and pigs...Oh My! The RG team lends it support to a farm animal rescue. Matt sets up his grills during a weekend fundraiser and stays friendly to his animal buddies by serving up a vegetarian menu. The menu: Portobello Burger Stack, Smoked Corn Tamale with Goat Cheese& Salsa Fresca, Pizza Salad Sandwich, and Tabbouleh Salad

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 Day at the Pool
programme.desc: The neighbourhood outdoor pool is a great way to cool down on a hot summer day. Matt and the Grill Team are dipping their feet in the pool, splashing with the kids, and, of course, grilling up some fabulous eats to munch on while playing in the park or relaxing on your towel. The menu: BBQ'd Pork Tenderloin & Pears on Bagels, Grilled Asian Chicken Burger, Surf & Turf Kabobs with Arugula Pesto, and BBQ'd Cinnamon Donuts.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E11 Chef's Graduation
programme.desc: It's graduation day at Chef School and Matt and the Grill team are sharing in the festivities. To congratulate the new Chefs, Matt has cooked up a masterful menu of fancy, yet simple, dishes. The menu: Mixed Seafood Grill on a Plank, Maple Rosemary Rotisserie Chicken, Dunked Hunan Lamb Rack, and Salmon Pastrami.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 Picnic Maze Craze
programme.desc: The Road Grill team goes rural and gets lost in hedge mazes at Saunders Farm. Luckily, they find their way out in time to cook up some BBQ and feed all families at the farm. The menu: Grilled Chicken Legs with Crunchy Chip Crust, Smoked Ham with Maple Mustard Glaze, Planked Asparagus Bundles with Cheese and Prosciutto, and Cobb Salad.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Summer Solstice
programme.desc: Summer Solstice is celebrated around the world with all manner of ritual and fun"... Holiday Eatz host Kimberly Lallouz is celebrating with a party menu that takes advantage of all those extra hours of sun! Homemade cheese in one day? You bet! It's easy and delicious in her Watermelon Salad with white balsamic vinegar and sunflower seed brittle. Her next course is grilled shrimp, scallops, avocados, and peaches? Yep! Washed down with a citrus spiked white sangria! A crispy skin pork belly Porchetta roast is next, stuffed with savoury summer herbs. For her finale, you'll love her rhubarb meringue pie, it's a mile high pie for a mile-wide smile"... what a way to spend the longest day!

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 Farmer's Market
programme.desc: Matt and the Team prepare BBQ Sunday Dinner with ingredients from the Farmers Market. Herbed Prime Rib, Grilled Pork Chops with Garlic and Herbs, Roasted Root Veggies with Mustard Glaze, and Yorkshire pudding will please friends and family alike!

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 Ethnic Market
programme.desc: Using internationally inspired recipes, Matt and the Road Grill team take us on a taste bud tour around the world with Stuffed Peppers, Bison Burgers with Oka Cheese, Tandoori Lamb Ribs and Tea Smoked Hoisin Duck.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E18 The Coed Charity Baseball Tournament
programme.desc: Matt and the Team cook up a mound of food for hungry athletes raising money for charity. No one went hungry with Beef Dip Sandwiches; Lemon Honey Garlic Baby Back Pork Ribs; and fresh Grilled Mahi-mahi with sweet Pineapple Tomatillo Salsa.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 Mother's Day Celebration
programme.desc: Everyone should treat Mom to a special breakfast! Matt and his team treated a crowd on Mother's Day to a BBQed Brunch. They feasted on Stuffed Blueberry Mascarpone French Toast, a Veggie Frittata, Applewood Smoked Canadian Bacon, and Fresh Fruit Smoothies

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 Buskers
programme.desc: The Buskers Festival is in town! The team hit the grill to do some BBQ entertaining. They cook up a feast for the crowd including a Roast of Pork with Concord Grape Sauce, Spicy Shrimp, and Beer Braised Sausage with Caramelized Onions

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 The Garage Sale
programme.desc: The Road Grill Team go to a neighbourhood Garage Sale, then treat everyone to everyday dishes with a twist. Matt and his team grill up some Grilled Porterhouse Steaks in a Homemade Steak Spice; Grilled Lemon Prosciutto Scallops; Planked Stuffed Potatoes and a Grilled Caesar Salad.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E22 The Dog Show
programme.desc: Matt loves animals - including dogs. He goes to a Dog Show to give dog lovers a little taste of what the QB is cooking - Garlicky Grilled Artichokes; Bacon Wrapped Halibut With Lime Scallion Sauce Sauce; Slow Cooked Spareribs With Guava Glaze; and A Summer Wild Berry Crisp.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E23 Cycle Day
programme.desc: Matt and the Team grill up some chow at a bike ride Fundraiser. They tempt the crowd with Hazelnut Crusted Halibut with Strawberry Salsa, Pork Picnic Roast with Blackberry Chipotle Glaze, Grilled Paninis with Roast Veggies, and Spinach Salad with Apples, Bacon and Cashews

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E24 Fitness Day
programme.desc: Matt and his team hit fitness central and cook up a grilled feast that is high on protein and lean on fat including Salt Crusted Peel and Eat Shrimp; Lime Chipotle Pork Medallions; Mesquite Smoked Turkey with Peach Glaze and a Sweet and Spicy Black Bean Salad.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E25 Charity Car Wash
programme.desc: Matt and the Road Grill team are pitching in to feed volunteers some great grilled chow including Lime Jalapeno Chicken Wings with Raita Dip; Beef Ribs with Vinegar Bbq Sauce; Killer Bbq Fries with Homemade Ketchup and Some Ice Cold Kiwi Melon Frostys

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 Cottage Party
programme.desc: Matt and the Team join some friends at a Cottage Party to celebrate the end of school. They keep the festivities going with Bbqed Rib Eye Steaks with a Chimmi Churri Sauce; Jerk Pulled Pork Sandwiches with Fresh Mango; Roasted Garlic Onion Potatoes and Greek Salad in a Pita.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 Soap Box Derby
programme.desc: Not only do the racers in the Soap Box Derby have a need for speed, they have a need for BBQ! Matt and the RG team cook up a feast to slow down any speedster. The menu: Smoked Shrimp B.L.T., Pineapple Basil Rotisserie Chicken, Grilled Sweet Potato Pops, and Summer Berry Pudding.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Day By the Water
programme.desc: Matt spends the day by the water; fishing, playing Frisbee, catching some rays. What goes with water and sun? BBQ!!! Matt & his team make a seafood buffet of Grilled Clams in the Shell with Serrano Ham, Smoked Lake Rainbow Trout, Grilled Lobster with Grapefruit Salsa, and Crab-Stuffed Avocados.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 Volleyball Tournament
programme.desc: Matt gets down and dirty playing some beach Volleyball. In between bumps, sets, and spikes, the RG team serves up a smorgasbord of great food. The menu: Grilled Chicken Breast on Foccacia with Grilled Apples & Cambozola Cheese, Sezchuan Ribs with Chunky Plum Dipping Sauce, Roasted Corn and Pepper Potato Salad, and Homemade Protein Bars

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 Big Bike Fundraiser
programme.desc: Forget bicycle built for two. This Big Bike fits 30 people! Matt & the team join forces with the Heart & Stroke foundation to raise money by riding around a track. Matt feeds these 'bikers' some healthy and delicious grub. The menu: Grilled Calamari, Smoked Turkey Fajitas, Grilled Scallops and Watermelon Salsa, and Cold Gazpacho.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 Air Show
programme.desc: It's a bird, it's a plane, it's a day of great BBQ. Inspired by the aerial acrobatics of CF18's and Harvards, Matt cooks up a variety of poultry and fowl. The menu: Bacon Wrapped Quail Stuffed with 3 Cream Cheeses, Raspberry Chipotle Turkey Wings, Grilled Balsamic Marinated Duck Breast, and Deviled Eggs.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 Golf Tournament
programme.desc: Whether you're a pro or a beginner, everyone is welcome to join the Road Grill team at the 19th tee where Matt is busy burnin' up his Q's. What better way to end your day at the links with an enticing menu of Miso Citrus Grilled Sablefish, Smoked Rack of Pork with a Sour Cherry Sauce , Lemon Basil Smashed Potatoes with Mushrooms, Arugula Salad with Peaches, and Blue Cheese and Walnuts.

programme.title: Road Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 Sailors Bon Voyage
programme.desc: In between hoisting sails and scrubbing the deck, Matt and his team prepare a feast for the sailors before going on a long voyage. Not only is the weather perfect for sailing, it's perfect for BBQing! The menu: Scallop Corn Bacon Burger, Maple-apple Brined Pork Chops, Grilled Tuna Bruschetta, and Strawberry Marscapone Trifle.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Lamb Four Ways
programme.desc: There are limitless options with lamb on the grill! Host Spencer Watts offers some tips and tricks on how to prepare four different cuts of lamb.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Fowl Play
programme.desc: Whether for a small family dinner or a big backyard barbeque, host Spencer Watts shows us the best ways to grill up tasty duck, turkey, capon, and quail.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Sides & Sweets with Heat
programme.desc: Never underestimate the power of a good side or dessert! Fun host Spencer Watts grills up the perfect sides and treats for your next barbeque.

programme.title: Holiday Eatz
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Summer Solstice
programme.desc: Summer Solstice is celebrated around the world with all manner of ritual and fun"... Holiday Eatz host Kimberly Lallouz is celebrating with a party menu that takes advantage of all those extra hours of sun! Homemade cheese in one day? You bet! It's easy and delicious in her Watermelon Salad with white balsamic vinegar and sunflower seed brittle. Her next course is grilled shrimp, scallops, avocados, and peaches? Yep! Washed down with a citrus spiked white sangria! A crispy skin pork belly Porchetta roast is next, stuffed with savoury summer herbs. For her finale, you'll love her rhubarb meringue pie, it's a mile high pie for a mile-wide smile"... what a way to spend the longest day!

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Allium in the Family
programme.desc: Onions, green onions, chives, garlic, and leeks are all members of the same fabulous flowering family, Allium! First up? Chef Watts shows us his sweet and smoky Charred Leeks with Romesco; add grilled toast and you have your next party appetizer! Next up is a main course. Spencer starts with a juicy grilled pork chop, then adds roasted garlic melted into a balsamic onion chutney to make his out-of-this-world Roasted Garlic Pork Chops. Looking for a crowd pleaser that's easy to make? Spencer has a recipe for that! Chicken Yakitori. He threads skewers with crunchy green onions and tender chicken and caramelizes the yakitori sauce as he grills this tasty dish. Are you ready to drool? Spencer...

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 Cheesy BBQ
programme.desc: Have a cheese lover coming over? Blow their minds with some of Spencer's "grate" barbecued cheese recipes! First up, Spencer chars Brie Cheese to an ooey-gooey perfection and tops it with tart cherries and crunchy walnuts, serving it with crispy grilled crostinis. Next up is a Grilled Steak and Caesar with a twist only Spencer could add - grilled... lettuce! Then, Spencer uses the classic German "hasselback" presentation to stuff chicken breasts with verdant spinach, yummy Swiss cheese and pungent sun- dried tomatoes, grilling them to melty perfection. Finally, Spencer fires up his barbecue to make his Grilled Peaches with Salted Bourbon Caramel, a decadent dessert elevated with creamy...

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 Achin' for Bacon
programme.desc: In this bacon loving episode, Chef Spencer delivers a tasty Bacon Weave Turkey Breast, which gets injected with beer and spices before being wrapped up in its cozy bacon blanket and sent off to the grill! Next up? A Peameal Bacon Roast with Rosti. This heavy hunk of back bacon gets smoked to flavourful perfection while Chef Watts makes the crispiest golden-fried-to-perfection potato pancake. Then, Spencer whips up a charry, grilled, super decadent, bacon-wrapped and bacon stuffed cheeseburger. Spencer isn't finished with bacon yet! For his final recipe, Spencer stuffs an apple with decadent crispy morsels stuffed along with savoury caramelized onions and melty cheddar cheese.

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 Grilled Veggies
programme.desc: This episode kicks off with Spencer's tasty Grilled Caesar Salad. He skillfully piles of char-grilled romaine lettuce wedges and sourdough croutons are topped with tangy dressing, crispy pancetta, and shards of a homemade parmesan tuile. For his next recipe, Spencer whips up Grilled Zucchini Boats that filled with fresh ingredients including orzo pasta, summer veggies, and herbs. Chef Watts loves a good steak and his Grilled Cauliflower Steak is not one to be passed up! Dusted in Middle Eastern Spices, flame roasted and served with chili-spiked, Yemeni 'Skhug' hot sauce and pomegranate seeds. Finally, Spencer steams tender artichokes, stuffing these flowers with breadcrumbs and...

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E06 Handheld Party Foods
programme.desc: The most liked post on any grill-master's social feed is 'meat on a stick' - and Chef Spencer's Turkish-style chicken kabob is worth every click! He marinates thick juicy chicken morsels in yogurt and spices, and then grills these flavourful skewers to a charry perfection. Next up is the creative 'Tornado Potato' which re- invents grilled potatoes with a wild presentation and a trio of toppings. Spencer then assembles Char Siu Sliders on tiny party- ready buns. Stuffed with a soy, honey and umami-packed hoisin lacquered slow-and-low grilled pork belly, these tasty little sliders will have your taste buds tingling. For his final recipe, Spencer whips up toasted crispy roti cups; topping...

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E07 Fire & Spice
programme.desc: Chef Spencer starts this spicy barbeque episode with flavours from Thailand with a Bok Choy with a Ginger Chili Sauce. Powerful bird's eye chilies are packed into a sweet and spicy sauce and served over tasty grilled bok choy. Spencer then introduces us to Calabrian chilies, mashed into a spice paste and rubbed on butterflied chicken that then gets grilled to flame-kissed perfection. Next, Spencer gives fresh calamari some heat with Korean chilies that add their distinctive heat and flavour before grilling this scrumptious recipe and serving it over a comforting bed of rice and peas. Finally, Spencer prepares Seekh Kabobs, made with ground lamb spiked with punchy dried Kashmiri chilies...

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 Spanish Flare
programme.desc: First stop on Chef Spencer's Spanish flavour tour? Habanero Char-Grilled Octopus - warmed up with punchy chilies and balanced with a sweet and tangy sherry vinaigrette. Next, Spencer stuffs whole sea bass with citrus and herbs, gives it the grill treatment and then tops it with olive oil blistered cherry tomatoes. The rotisserie does the heavy lifting for Mr. Watts' whole roast chicken - spiked with bright Spanish flavours like Spanish chilies and smoked paprika, slow cooked and served extra juicy. Finally, Spencer prepares a classic Spanish recipe: Paella. Loaded saffron rice, piled high with chorizo, veggies, and shellfish. Of course, Spencer's Paella is made in the Spanish tradition;...

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E09 The Butter Did It
programme.desc: It's all about beautiful butter in this episode of Watts on the Grill! First up, entertaining host Spencer fires tosses clams in velvety butter, zesty garlic and earthy spices to make his Clams with Garlic Paprika Butter. Next up is a traditional Indian recipe, but done on the grill - Butter Chicken! All the butter chicken flavours we love are infused in the marinade, before getting crisped up on the fiery grill - the result is both classic and completely new! Scallops are next, grilled and served with a mouth-watering caper-raisin butter. For his final recipe; Chef Watts prepares a rich and juicy grilled Rib Steak topped with a decadent port wine compound butter. Oh, what a butter-loving...

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E10 Salt Rocks!
programme.desc: We've all cooked with salt. But what about ON salt. That's right, chef Spencer Watts blows our minds with his seared scallops that are cooked on a Himalayan pink salt block. His next recipe uses a quick cure with Hawaiian black lava salt on swordfish steaks, then tops them with a gorgeous and refreshing grilled fruit salsa. Then, Spencer gets creative with Cured Duck Legs with Scallions, using a salt cure to intensify the flavours of duck leg before it's cooked slow and low, then glazed with maple and soy. After cooking on salt, curing with salt, the only thing left is to cook INSIDE salt - Spencer's Salt Crusted Prime Rib is a game changer, flavourful, bone-in beef that he seasons with a...

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E11 Cocoa-Q
programme.desc: Chocolate on the barbecue? That's right. Chef Spencer Watts kicks off this episode as he grills a crispy coconut-cacao crust and serves it with sweet chili dipping sauce. Chocolate is the not-so-secret ingredient in Spencer's Grilled Chicken Molé. He grills the chicken legs smothered in the sweet-spicy-salty-nutty-creamy-chocolatey sauce, then finishes it by cooking it slow and low. Next, dark chocolate cocoa powder is in both the rub and the sauce for Chef Watts' favourite pork rib recipe - Cocoa-rubbed Baby Back Ribs. For his final recipe, Spencer takes it to a sweet level with his Chocolate pizza made with chocolate ganache, grilled cherries, with barbeque- caramelized white chocolate...

programme.title: Watts On the Grill
programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 The Art of Wood
programme.desc: It's time to celebrate the art of smoking with wood! You'll drool over Spencer's Cherrywood Smoked Chicken Wings, dry rubbed with his favourite spices and smoked with cherrywood. Next, Spencer marinates sable fish in Japanese ingredients and grills it on a sweet-smoky cedar plank. Then, Spencer shows off his Texas BBQ skills with his Mesquite Smoked Skirt Steak. Engulfed in a thick cloud of white smoke, this skirt steak has the flavour and texture of tasty brisket, but made in a fraction amount of time. Finally, Spencer gives a pork shoulder a long, smoky cook in oak wood. The wait is worth it as he serves it piled high on a bun and topped with a mustardy Carolina BBQ sauce.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S03 : E05 Fun with Woks
programme.desc: Host Mary Tang shows us some easy Chinese take-out dishes that are a true "wok" in the park! First, she rolls up some juicy wontons to douse in a bowl of hot seasoned chicken broth and delicious bok choy for a Chinese classic - Wonton Soup. Next, she gets out her frying pan for a crispy bowl of flavourful Chicken Chow Mein with egg noodles, savoury browned chicken, crunchy snow peas, and tasty baby corn. For an even simpler dish (and fan favourite), she then cooks up a hearty dish of Beef and Broccoli. Finally, Mary plays on different flavours with her Sweet and Sour Pork. Marinated pork cubes fried in a wonderful wok with fragrant garlic and ginger, sweet and tart red and green peppers,...

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S03 : E12 Vietnam's Love for Noodles
programme.desc: Noodles are a staple in Vietnamese cooking and host Lisa Nguyen showcases their versatility by starting off with fine vermicelli Stuffed Squid. Beautifully grilled and charred, these squid make great finger food. Lisa sticks to stuffing with her next dish - a Vietnamese favourite, Spring Rolls. Crunchy on the outside and filled with soft glass noodles, juicy ground pork, tender shrimp, and delectable crab meat on the inside, you're sure to be salivating at the sight of these tasty creations. Next on the menu, a Crispy Egg Noodle Pillow with a medley of vegetables and sauces on top. Lisa then finishes with a fun seafood and tomato soup; make sure you try the yummy shrimp and delightful...

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S03 : E19 Four Course Lebanese
programme.desc: Host Jasmin Ibrahim gives us the lowdown on her four favourite Lebanese dishes for a tasty meal. The best part? They all incorporate sweet and crunchy pomegranate! First, she makes a smoked eggplant dish - Baba Ghanouj. Then, she prepares a delicious Pastry with Pomegranate Sauce. These little half-moons, are filled with rich lamb, fresh mint, and toasted pine nuts, then paired with citrusy pomegranate molasses for a true balance of flavours. Next on the menu, Chicken with Pomegranate Sauce - a delightful blend of aromatic spices, sweet pomegranate molasses, and tender chicken breast. Enjoy with some fluffy rice and roasted vegetables for a delectable Sunday night dinner. Finally, Jasmin...

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S03 : E26 OPA!
programme.desc: Host Joanna Chery elevates four Greek dishes using wine and spirits in this episode of One World Kitchen. First up, brown rice Stuffed Mussels infused with Greek dry white wine, tangy lemon juice, and fragrant spices - perfect for a sunny day by the sea. When evening rolls around, Joanna insists that red wine is a must! She makes a Sausage and Pepper Stew packed with golden-brown sausages and colourful bell peppers simmered in yummy tomatoes and a healthy dose of red wine. Then, she pulls out some brandy for a tender and delicious Beef Orzo Casserole. Finally, Joanna uses a traditional licorice-flavoured spirit called ouzo to bake a mouth-watering batch of Drunk Cookies.

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Tea Party Treats
programme.desc: High tea requires royal desserts! Host Jessica McGovern gives us the lowdown on some sophisticated sweets to pair with a warm cup of tea.

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Impress Your Kids
programme.desc: Talented host Jessica McGovern shows us how to impress both kids and adults with three ovERS-the-top desserts including a magical Geode Cake.

programme.title: VegHeadz
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Summer
programme.desc: Nothing screams summer more than salsa, especially chef Pino's sunshine yellow salsa served with grilled halloumi cheese. Yes, please! Next up, snappy snow peas pair with summer strawberries in a sprouted quinoa salad with Champagne vinaigrette! Pino then takes summer sunbathing to the next level, serving up blistered Shishito peppers and buttery radishes with sesame seeds and edible seaweed! For his final dish, Pino sums up summer with a French-style ratatouille served as a salad! Thinly sliced vegetables are lightly marinated before pairing with a fresh carrot purée in a dish that sparkles with summer.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S03 : E15 Lebanese Culinary Favourites
programme.desc: What better way to start a meal than with dessert? Lebanese home cook Jasmin Ibrahim shows us how to make a gooey cheese pastry doused in sweet syrup called Knafeh. With a buttery golden-brown crust, oozy melted cheese and fragrant rose water, this decadent dessert will surely satisfy your sweet tooth. Next on the menu, a Lebanese classic - pita bread. You'll never buy it from the store again with this delightfully easy recipe! Jasmin then prepares a well-known Lebanese sandwich - you guessed it, Shawarma! Loaded with charred chicken, a popular Lebanese 7 spice mix, and yummy garlic sauce, this might be the best sandwich ever! Finally, Jasmin cooks up a batch of tasty Beirut Spicy Fish -...

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.sub-title: S01 : E15 Peru + Lebanon
programme.desc: Tiraditos! No, it's not a joyous exclamation (even though it sounds a little like one...) it's a Peruvian dish that lands somewhere between traditional Peruvian ceviche and Japanese sashimi. Chef Craig Wong's version is made with swordfish and includes sweet potatoes pureed with spicy Aji Amarillo chilies. For his Lebanese tribute, check out Lamb Neck cured and slow-poached in olive oil for a melt-in- your-mouth result, paired with an intense, flavourful Black Baba Ghanoush made with charred eggplant and caramelized onions. For a common ingredient, it is two takes on potato: Lomo Saltado with grilled flank steak, and a cheese, herb, olive oil and lemon drenched Hasselback Batata Harra....

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S03 : E21 All Sorts of Spice
programme.desc: Spices are extremely important to Lebanese cuisine and host Jasmin Ibrahim uses a ton of them in four tasty Lebanese dishes. First, she prepares two classic, aromatic toppings for a Lebanese breakfast bread called Mana- keesh. Next up, juicy chicken and smokey freekah seasoned with sweet cinnamon, citrusy cardamom, pungent all spice, and black peppercorns. This dish captures the essence of Lebanese cuisine. Moving on, Jasmin then makes a thick and spicy beef stew. It's eaten vermicelli rice and seasoned with a classic Lebanese 7-spice combo. Fragrant and delicious, this dish can be served family-style for everyone to enjoy! For dessert, Jasmin whips up a wonderfully rich batch of Spiced...

programme.title: Cook the Books
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 A Generous Meal
programme.desc: Chef-host Shahir Massoud tries out recipes from an award-winning cookbook: A Generous Meal by his culinary school classmate, Christine Flynn! Follow along as Shahir makes craveable pumpkin stuffed shells, a juicy porkchop with fennel slaw, a refreshing peach and corn salad, and much more!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S03 : E06 Cantonese Seafood
programme.desc: Bring on the seafood! Home cook Mary Tang kicks off this episode of One World Kitchen 3 with a unique dish featuring chewy clams, sweet and bitter fermented black beans, and a collection of spices. Next, she makes us her favourite shrimp dish - Shrimp and Egg Fried Rice. Fluffy egg bits, lightly flavoured nutty brown rice, and a pop of tender shrimp works wonders for the taste buds. A common appetizer, Mary then walks us through a spicy concoction of deep-fried salt and pepper squid or Calamari. And who doesn't love lobster? Mary finishes off with Cantonese Lobster with Ginger and Scallions (yes, it tastes as good as it sounds!). A Cantonese take on the juicy protein, this dish is fried...

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S03 : E13 Balancing Sweet with Savoury
programme.desc: A tasty four-course Vietnamese meal using fruit? Yes, please! For her first dish, talented home cook Lisa Nguyen uses tangy tamarind pulp to balance flavours in a savoury bowl of Vietnamese Sour Fish Soup. Then, she combines tart pomelo and sweet pineapple with juicy crab meat for a flavourful salad. Next up, hot Chicken Coconut Curry with a hint of citrusy lemongrass, sweet potatoes, and a kaffir lime leaf. Pair it with a warm, toasty baguette and you're good to go! Lisa's last dish is a mouth-watering, classic Vietnamese dessert. Soft and chewy Steamed Banana Cake drizzled in a sweet velvety coconut sauce crunchy sesame seeds will have you begging for more!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S03 : E20 Lebanese Small Plates
programme.desc: Talented home cook Jasmin Ibrahim prepares delicious, sharable small plates in this episode of One World Kitchen. First on the menu, Grilled Lamb Skewers. Wonderfully charred and seasoned with sweet cinnamon, potent all-spice, and a punch of garlic, these lamb skewers will be the hype at your next family get-together! Then, Jasmin makes a famous Lebanese classic - Falafel and Hummus (so tasty!). Next up, savoury Zucchini Fritters with a zesty yogurt sauce are added to the mix for a little dinner party pizzazz. Finally, Jasmin's favourite cheese is the star of this next dish - Grilled Halloumi. Served with a sweet and citrusy rose drink, this small plate will have your guests going crazy!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S03 : E27 Cheese with Every Meal!
programme.desc: Cheese - a staple in traditional Greek cuisine! Talented home cook Joanna Chery fries up two delicious ap- petizers called Saganaki, both featuring two different types of cheese. First, she fries up kefaltyri, a hard, salty cheese in a dramatic burning flame of ouzo (licorice-flavoured alcohol) - Opa! Then, Joanna shows us a popular Fried Shrimp and Cheese appetizer using tasty feta and tender shrimp. Pair both dishes with a Greek rustic bread and you've nailed it! Next up, Joanna prepares a Greek classic - Spanakopita. This mouth-watering dish is made up of creamy ricotta, crispy phyllo pastry, fresh spinach, and a hint of dill (yum!). Moving on, Joanna showcases her all-time favourite...

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.sub-title: S01 : E09 Flowers!
programme.desc: Flowers aren't just for smelling - they're great for baking too! Host Jessica McGovern shows us how to bake some tasty desserts with a floral twist.

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 All About Eggs
programme.desc: Host Jessica McGovern shows us the versatility of eggs by baking up some tasty, egg-centric desserts like CrÃ¨me Brulee and Lemon Meringue Pie.

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.sub-title: S01 : E11 Comfort Food
programme.desc: Baking host Jessica McGovern warms up the kitchen with some melty, creamy, and chewy treats to comfort you on a rainy day.

programme.title: Flour Power
programme.sub-title: S01 : E12 Rich and Delicious
programme.desc: Baking is indulgent - especially when making rich and delicious treats! Host Jessica McGovern shares some foolproof recipes for all things rich.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.sub-title: S02 : E23 Noodles and Nectarines
programme.desc: For this "N" challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas works with noodles and nectarines. For her first dish, Lauren cooks up a breaded nectarine and mozzarella stack. Talking technique, she shows us how to cut nectarines into rounds. She does the same with some soft mozzarella and then walks us through the art of a balsamic reduction. For the noodles, Chef Lauren puts an elegant twist on your childhood favourite with a lobster mac and cheese. She spares no flavours, adding fried bacon, garlic, cayenne pepper, mustard powder, and even dry vermouth. This is no ordinary noodle dish. But now for the real challenge! Chef Lauren works with the noodles and nectarines.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.sub-title: S02 : E08 Okra and Oats
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Robert Jewell explores recipes using two very different ingredients that start with the letter "O," oats and okra. For his first dish, Robert uses okra in a classic cornmeal cake recipe, but bumps up the flavour factor with spicy jalapenos. Robert balances the heat of the jalapeno with a tart green tomato and crunchy red onion salsa. In his next recipe, Robert keeps the heat, but switches up his recipes for a curry-spiced oat pancake. This Indian inspired dish needs something to cool it down and Robert knows exactly what that is - sweet, silky applesauce! He's up for the challenge when it comes to combining okra and oats into one dish, and the results are tasty!

programme.title: Cook Like a Chef
programme.sub-title: S06 : E05 White Fish Episode with Chef Katie Ardington
programme.desc: Skilled Chef Katie Ardington is excited to introduce her favourite fish, striped sea bass, in this fabulous voyage through the 7 seas of seafood cookery.

programme.title: Cook Like a Chef
programme.sub-title: S06 : E06 Chicken Episode with Chef Natalia Machado
programme.desc: Chef-host Natalia Machado loves chicken, and who doesn't? Chicken is enjoyed around the world for good reason; it is versatile and reliably delicious!

programme.title: Cook Like a Chef
programme.sub-title: S06 : E07 Salad Episode with Chef Craig Wong
programme.desc: Salad is a wonderful addition to any meal, and sometimes even a meal on its own"... today, the talented Chef Craig Wong shares several of his superior salad ideas.

programme.title: Cook Like A Chef
programme.sub-title: S06 : E08 Pork Episode with Chef Derek Dammann
programme.desc: Snout to tail cooking is Chef Derek Dammann's specialty, in this episode celebrating pork, he cooks everything but the squeal!

programme.title: Fresh Market Dinners
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Honey, Cherries, Garlic Scapes and Carrots
programme.desc: Host Amanda Herrera transforms market fresh honey, cherries, garlic scapes and carrots into two simple chic sides and an irresistible dessert.

programme.title: Fresh Market Dinners
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Sprouts, Veggies and Potatoes
programme.desc: Host Amanda Herrera creates two summer fresh salads and a hearty breakfast using sprouts, potatoes and leafy lambs quarters.

programme.title: Fresh Market Dinners
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 Kohlrabi, Fennel, Kale and Red Cabbage
programme.desc: Host Amanda Herrera shows us why fresh is always best with two creative dishes using ingredients from the farmers' market.

programme.title: Everyday Excellent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E23 High Protein
programme.desc: With only 30 minutes and the clock ticking, can Vanessa make a protein packed meal for 4 for about 40 bucks? On the menu: quinoa and edamame salad, mini meatloaves, and oatmeal chocolate chip protein bites!

programme.title: Everyday Excellent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E22 Free Of
programme.desc: With only 30 minutes and the clock ticking, can Vanessa make an allergen friendly meal for 4 for about 40 bucks? On the menu: kale and lentil salad with green goddess dressing, chickpea curry, and avocado key lime pie cups!

programme.title: Everyday Excellent
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 Breakfast for Dinner
programme.desc: With only 30 minutes and the clock ticking, can Vanessa make breakfast for dinner for 4 for about 40 bucks? On the menu: a veggie frittata, sweet and peppery bacon, a cottage cheese pancake stack, and fruit skewers!

Loaded with charred chicken, a popular Lebanese 7 spice mix, and yummy garlic sauce, this might be the best sandwich ever! Finally, Jasmin cooks up a batch of tasty Beirut Spicy Fish -...

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Italy
programme.sub-title: S03 : E04 Hell's Kitchen Italia S3 E4
programme.desc: I cuochi ricreano la pizza, simbolo dell'Italia, con l'aiuto di Simone Padoan. Un concorrente guadagna l'immunità in questa prova cruciale. Dopo, c'è un servizio serale con ospiti importanti, ma entrambe le squadre affrontano notevoli difficoltà, portando alla chiusura anticipata del servizio senza vincitori.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Italy

programme.desc: Lo chef Cracco mette alla prova i cuochi testando le loro tecniche culinarie con due menu: uno crudo e uno cotto.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Italy
programme.sub-title: S03 : E06 Hell's Kitchen Italia S3 E6
programme.desc: In questo episodio di "Hell's Kitchen", Mara Maionchi e Frank Matano si uniscono alle squadre Rossa e Blu. Prima del servizio, i cuochi affrontano un esercizio di comunicazione: bendati o imbavagliati, devono replicare un piatto dello Chef Cracco.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Italy
programme.sub-title: S03 : E07 Hell's Kitchen Italia S3 E7
programme.desc: Il ristorante ospita Chef Kumalé, esperto di cucina etnica, per il primo test. Le brigate devono preparare menu con piatti di street food.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Italy
programme.sub-title: S03 : E08 Hell's Kitchen Italia S3 E8
programme.desc: Lo chef Cracco valuta la capacità di mescolare cucine straniere e italiane. L'immunità dall'eliminazione è in palio per un servizio con lo chef Pedro Miguel Schiaffino, esperto di cucina peruviana. Tre nuovi piatti vengono aggiunti al menu.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen

programme.desc: Le squadre sono sfidati a scavare le proprie patate per creare un piatto a base di patate.

programme.desc: Tra gli ospiti a cena c’è l'attrice e l'ambasciatore della celebrità di Oxfam, Minnie Driver.

programme.desc: I restanti concorrenti cucinano versioni gourmet di street food.

programme.desc: La leggenda dei fumetti Stan Lee si siede al tavolo dello chef.

programme.desc: La gara di cucina raggiunge il suo culmine.

programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay divide gli chef in due squadre di uomini e donne per la loro prima sfida.

programme.desc: Un risotto mal riuscito potrebbe segnare la fine per uno sfortunato concorrente.

programme.sub-title: S13 : E03 16 Chefs Competono
programme.desc: Gli chef realizzano le ricette stampate sul retro delle loro giacche da servire a ospiti VIP.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S13 : E04 15 Chefs Competono
programme.desc: Gordon sfida il team a fare catering ad una cerimonia di laurea.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Italy
programme.sub-title: S03 : E09 Hell's Kitchen Italia S3 E9
programme.desc: L'ospite al ristorante di Carlo Cracco è l'esperto Carlo Spinelli, che porta ingredienti insoliti come fiori, alghe, sali stranieri e insetti. I cuochi affrontano l'ardua sfida di creare un piatto con questi ingredienti, mettendoli in difficoltà con un menu azzardato per il pranzo.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Italy
programme.sub-title: S03 : E10 Hell's Kitchen Italia S3 E10
programme.desc: I cuochi delle due brigate trascorrono un pomeriggio avventuroso nella campagna pavese, raccogliendo ingredienti e cucinando in situazioni estreme per creare un piatto gourmet. Lo chef Cracco incontra i cuochi individualmente per valutarli e decidere l'immunità, mentre due chef prendono la guida della propria brigata.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Italy
programme.sub-title: S03 : E11 Hell's Kitchen Italia S3 E11
programme.desc: Come primo test, i cuochi devono creare un piatto ispirato a un giocattolo. La squadra blu vince. Nel servizio del pranzo, i clienti votano i menu tramite un'app, ma nonostante sia il più popolare, il menu rosso riceve meno stelle, causando la sconfitta della squadra.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Italy
programme.sub-title: S03 : E12 Hell's Kitchen Italia S3 E12
programme.desc: I 6 chef rimanenti si avvicinano alla giacca nera. Nel primo test, preparano risotti che riflettono la loro identità, mentre Guglielmo e Shaban emergono come i migliori dei loro team. Guglielmo ottiene la prima giacca nera. Durante il servizio, i cuochi sono osservati da Bottura e alla fine, le giacche nere rimanenti vengono consegnate a Carlotta, Shaban, Kristian e Amalia in questo ordine.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen Italy
programme.sub-title: S03 : E13 Hell's Kitchen Italia S3 E13
programme.desc: Dopo una serata di "eccessi", i cuochi devono preparare piatti detox con Pierangelo Dacrema come ospite. Nel primo servizio con la giacca nera, i migliori cuochi delle prime due edizioni di "Hell's Kitchen Italia" sfidano i concorrenti con un menu dei migliori piatti delle tre edizioni.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S13 : E05 14 Chefs Competono
programme.desc: Le squadre cucinano per la madre di Gordon, Helen.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen
programme.sub-title: S13 : E06 13 Chefs Competono
programme.desc: Gli animi si infiammano quando Gordon rimprovera le squadre di regredire piuttosto che progredire.
